t: About Pierre – Pierre Alex Jeanty
s: Pierre Alex Jeanty, most widely known for his international best sellers HER & HER Vol.2, is a Haitian-American author, publisher, and entrepreneur. Often approached for relationship advice and dealing with the same issues himself, Pierre found a passion for writing on the topics of dating, love, and relationships.
